connectors.description: Read pull requests, reviews and checks for the workspace repository with the GitHub CLI (gh). Read-only queries.
Host slot 2 for gh. hvir allows one host per connector, so approve this for a different host than gh; views pick the slot approved for the workspace's host.
Host slot 3 for gh. hvir allows one host per connector, so approve this for a different host than gh; views pick the slot approved for the workspace's host.
Read the current branch and remotes of the workspace checkout so This branch can list its pull request.
Host slot 2 for git. hvir allows one host per connector, so approve this for a different host than git; views pick the slot approved for the workspace's host.
Host slot 3 for git. hvir allows one host per connector, so approve this for a different host than git; views pick the slot approved for the workspace's host.

Open a terminal in another worktree of this repository when its branch is already checked out there. Runs zsh -c 'cd <worktree> && exec $SHELL -l' only from the pull request view's button, after you confirm each launch; the worktree must be one git worktree list reports.

actions.title: List pull requests that need attention
actions.description: Read-only. Ranked like the PRs pane (ADR-976 holder wait in business time): sections branch, needs (waiting on you), waiting (yours, waiting on others), drafts. Returns compact rows, each with role author (the viewer's pull request) or reviewer (an ask from someone else); 'omitted' counts rows dropped to fit the 8 KiB result.

actions.title: Read one pull request's review and check status
actions.description: Read-only. For a pull request number in the workspace's repository: state, draft, review decision, requested reviewers, and check counts with up to 10 failing check names.

actions.title: Check out a pull request in a new terminal
actions.description: Runs gh pr checkout <number> -R <repo> once in a new terminal at the workspace root, after you confirm in hvir. Local workspaces only: hvir's terminal.start admits only connectors approved for the local host.

actions.title: Open a terminal in a worktree of this repository
actions.description: Opens a new terminal in another worktree of this repository, after you confirm in hvir. The path must be listed by git worktree list. Local workspaces only.
